replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA involves finding directions of maximum variance in data. You calculate covariance matrix, then eigenvectors and eigenvalues. It's not too complex; focus on understanding the concepts rather than memorizing formulas.
replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: LLMs can provide personalized explanations, generate practice problems, and offer instant feedback. They can also help visualize abstract concepts, making math more engaging and accessible.
